tasks.title: Author native change, bug and assess profiles
tasks.goal: Express reusable profiles over the existing change/fact/lifecycle primitives without adding a workflow engine.
steps: Use accepted M-02/M-04 schemas to author fixture flow profiles for change, bug and assess with explicit source facts/questions/acceptance references.
Bind each to existing operations and neutral evidence queries; keep scheduling, next-task selection and closure decisions external.
Expose profile definitions and provenance through the shared service catalog and preserve one exact origin across consumers.
positive_cases: Each profile creates a distinct local binding without copying upstream acceptance state.
A read-only assess result reports observations rather than an automatic verdict.
negative_cases: No private workflow cursor, implicit loop or automatic production is introduced.
A truncated/unclassified fact set cannot be called complete acceptance.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-requirements target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-requirements <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-orchestrator target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-orchestrator <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
acceptance: Profile fixtures load under existing kind/choice/change semantics.
Machine inspection identifies exact origin and expected evidence for every profile.
tasks.safe_stop: Native profile definitions and read-only binding cases are ready.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(examples): define native change bug and assess profiles
notes: Example directories are proposed fixture/canonical-example paths, not existing shipped products.

tasks.title: Connect procedure scripts to explicit admitted actions
tasks.goal: Make required bridge/native script steps executable only through their declared typed effect route.
steps: Consume the audited action matrix and M-08 command/grant contracts; prepare exact inputs, executable identity and effect scope.
Route a required script step through the existing operation/lifecycle service with target-bound authority and captured outputs.
Verify passive read/derive/profile selection cannot dispatch it, while explicit invocation returns truthful result/partial error and recovery references.
positive_cases: One required script action runs with exact approved inputs in an isolated target.
Profile reads expose the action contract without running it.
negative_cases: Changed script capture/argv/effect scope invalidates prior authority.
Failed/unsupported mandatory action prevents journey acceptance.
